name: PhotoSwipe Inline Text Filter
description: A text-format filter that wraps inline tags so body-content images open in a PhotoSwipe lightbox.
project_description: There is the PhotoSwipe module. If you want to open your inline images (inserted via CKEditor for example) in PhotoSwipe, you normally need to MANUALLY add HTML tags and CSS classes. This module adds a text filter that does it automatically: insert images any way you like and they open in PhotoSwipe. Works with CKEditor. Enable the filter on a text format under Administration > Configuration > Content authoring > Text formats and editors. Depends on the PhotoSwipe module (>= 5).
